message: function parameters must define type annotations
remediation: Annotate every parameter with the value type accepted by the function.

message: functions must define return type annotations
remediation: Declare the returned value type, using None when the function returns no value.

message: module-level variables must define type annotations
remediation: Add an explicit annotation to the first module-level assignment.

message: class attributes must define type annotations
remediation: Annotate the class attribute where it is first assigned.

message: local variables must define type annotations on first binding unless assigned a scalar literal
remediation: Annotate first bindings whose type is not evident from a number, string, bool, bytes, or f-string literal.

message: use absolute imports; relative imports hide package boundaries
remediation: Replace relative imports with an absolute import path.

message: star imports hide names from dependency-boundary analysis
remediation: Import each required name explicitly.

message: subpackage code must not import sibling internals
remediation: Publish the dependency through the owning sibling's main/ entry or role files.

message: cross-package imports must use public surfaces, not helpers or internals
remediation: Import from classes, models, types, constants, exceptions, or a thin main/ entry.

constraints.description: Subdomain paths exempt from internal public-surface imports
constraints.name: exempt_subdomain_paths

message: internal code must import from the owning module, not the bare package
remediation: Import from the concrete owning module below the package surface.

message: domain-private main entries may only be imported within their owning domain
remediation: Remove the leading underscore to publish the main entry, or route the caller through a public main entry owned by the target domain.

message: public main entries must have an importer outside their owning domain
remediation: Prefix the entry module filename with '_' until another domain or tooling imports it.

message: helper-private classes are file-local details; move shared classes to classes/
remediation: If another module needs this class, move it to the owning classes/ package.

message: runtime code must not import from tooling modules
remediation: Move reusable logic into the runtime package or keep the dependency inside tooling.

message: docstrings must be a single line; move extended explanation into docs or tests
remediation: Keep one concise summary line and move extended rationale into documentation or tests.

constraints.description: Allowed standalone comment prefixes
constraints.name: allowed_standalone_comment_prefixes

message: standalone comments are not allowed; prefer clear names or docs/tests
remediation: Replace the comment with clearer names or move lasting explanation into documentation or tests. Tooling directives beginning with these prefixes are allowed: #!, # -*-, # coding:, # noqa, # type:, # pyright:, # pylint:, # pragma:.

message: runtime code must raise structured errors instead of raw built-in exceptions
remediation: Raise a domain-specific exception from exceptions.py with a stable actionable message.

message: runtime code must not use assert for invariants; raise a structured error
remediation: Replace assert with an explicit guard that raises a domain-specific exception.

message: runtime code must not swallow broad exceptions as existence probe answers
remediation: Use an explicit metadata or existence check, or catch only the expected exception and preserve failures.

message: nested or multi-generator comprehensions hide control flow and data shapes
remediation: Extract a named helper when the transformation has a coherent purpose. For one-off local logic, use simple statements with named intermediate values instead of nested comprehension control flow.

message: string literals must not directly control comparison behavior
remediation: Name the decision value in constants.py or compare against an enum member so the branch expresses the concept it represents.

message: non-canonical numeric literals must not directly control comparisons
remediation: Name the threshold or sentinel in constants.py and compare against that name; only -1, 0, and 1 are self-explanatory comparison values.

message: runtime and tooling modules must not execute standalone calls during import
remediation: Move the operation into an explicit function or assign a pure constructor result.

message: main functions must stay phase-shaped and below the statement limit
remediation: Extract cohesive phases into helpers that return explicit result models.

message: main functions must not coordinate too many distinct callees
remediation: Group related work into named phase helpers and keep main/ as a short ordered flow.

message: main functions must not juggle too many local variables
remediation: Let each extracted phase own its intermediates and return one structured result.

message: functions must stay below the configured argument limit
remediation: Reduce the function's responsibility or group cohesive inputs into a typed model.

message: functions must stay below the global statement limit
remediation: Split the function at a meaningful phase boundary with explicit inputs and outputs. Top-level main functions are governed by FFS001 instead.

message: main orchestrators must consume meaningful project-local call results
remediation: Assign, return, or explicitly discard the phase result with _ = call(...).

constraints.description: Function kinds exempt from parameter-mutation enforcement
constraints.name: exempt_function_kinds

message: helpers must return values instead of mutating parameters
remediation: Return a new or updated value so dataflow remains visible to the caller.

constraints.description: Function kinds exempt from parameter-mutation enforcement
constraints.name: exempt_function_kinds

message: functions that mutate parameters must return every mutated parameter
remediation: Return each mutated parameter explicitly, or avoid parameter mutation and return a new value.

message: functions beyond the parameter threshold must be entirely keyword-only
remediation: Insert * before the first non-receiver parameter so every call argument names its meaning. Dunder methods are exempt.

message: functions must not mutate module-global or closure-captured state
remediation: Pass state explicitly and return the updated value instead of mutating outer scope.

message: nested or multi-generator comprehensions hide control flow and data shapes
remediation: Extract a named helper when the transformation has a coherent purpose. For one-off local logic, use simple statements with named intermediate values instead of nested comprehension control flow.

message: dataclass result models must be frozen
remediation: Declare the shared result model with @dataclass(frozen=True).

message: tests must live under a configured test root and supported scope
remediation: Move the test beneath a configured test root and one of the configured test_scopes.

message: test scope must be one of the configured test scopes
remediation: Move the test beneath a configured test root and one of the configured test_scopes.

message: test directories must mirror a configured runtime or tooling root
remediation: Mirror the complete configured source or tooling path beneath the test scope.

message: runtime tests must include an area beneath the configured source root
remediation: Move the test beneath the package and source area it exercises.

message: runtime tests must mirror a configured source package
remediation: Correct the mirrored package name or move the test to the package it exercises.

message: runtime tests must mirror an existing source package area
remediation: Correct the mirrored area path so it matches the runtime module location.

message: tooling tests must include an area beneath the configured tooling root
remediation: Move the test beneath the configured tooling area it exercises.

message: tooling tests must mirror an existing configured tooling area
remediation: Correct the mirrored area path so it matches the tooling location.

message: test package __init__.py files must be empty or docstring-only
remediation: Remove runtime declarations from __init__.py and import them from their owning module.

message: tests must use absolute imports
remediation: Replace the relative import with the full tests or application package path.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: test modules may contain only tests, imports, and declarations
remediation: Move reusable functions into the local helpers.py module.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

constraints.description: Test helper filenames included in conditional-flow enforcement
constraints.name: helper_module_filenames

message: tests and local test helpers must not contain conditional control flow
remediation: Use parametrized cases when setup and assertions remain branch-free; otherwise split the behavior into separate test functions. Keep local test helpers deterministic with per-variant functions or dataclass-driven case data.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: private test constants must appear before test functions
remediation: Move the private constant above the first test so module setup is visible before behavior.

message: nested or multi-generator comprehensions hide control flow and data shapes
remediation: Extract a named helper when the transformation has a coherent purpose. For one-off local logic, use simple statements with named intermediate values instead of nested comprehension control flow.

message: test-case dataclasses must define a description field
remediation: Add description: str so parametrized cases explain the behavior they represent.

message: test-case dataclasses must define at least one expected_ field
remediation: Name expected outcomes with an expected_ prefix and assert against them in the test.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: tests must import test-case types from their local _test_types.py
remediation: Move the dataclass beside the test and import it through the mirrored absolute path.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: test directories must provide a local _test_types.py
remediation: Create _test_types.py beside the test. Custom-rule tests should define a local wrapper dataclass there rather than parametrizing directly with RuleCase.

constraints.description: Scenario model filenames requiring dataclass-only declarations
constraints.name: scenario_model_filenames

message: scenario model modules may contain only imports and dataclass declarations
remediation: Decorate each scenario model with @dataclass or move non-model behavior into a focused helper module.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: test modules must use a test_ filename
remediation: Rename the module to test_<behavior>.py.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: test functions must use test_given_<state>_when_<action>_then_<outcome>
remediation: Rename the test so its precondition, action, and expected behavior are explicit.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: tests must use dataclass-backed pytest parameterization
remediation: Add @pytest.mark.parametrize with local test_case dataclass instances.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: parametrized tests must accept a test_case argument
remediation: Name the parameter test_case and read inputs and expectations from that object.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: test_case parameters must use a local test-case dataclass annotation
remediation: Annotate test_case with a dataclass imported from the local _test_types.py.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: tests must assert against an expected_ field from test_case
remediation: Store the expected outcome on test_case and reference it in a behavior assertion.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: pytest parametrize decorators must define parameter names and values
remediation: Pass both the parameter-name string and the case sequence to parametrize.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: pytest parametrize must expose cases through the test_case parameter
remediation: Use "test_case" as the parametrize parameter name.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: pytest parametrize decorators must define readable case ids
remediation: Set ids to the case descriptions, normally with ids=lambda case: case.description.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: pytest parametrize values must be a visible list, tuple, or local comprehension
remediation: Inline the case sequence in @pytest.mark.parametrize so its cases are visible beside the test.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: pytest parametrize case sequences must not be empty
remediation: Add at least one behavior case or remove the test until a real case exists.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: pytest cases must use typed dataclasses instead of dictionaries
remediation: Define a local frozen test-case dataclass and construct one instance per case.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: pytest cases must construct dataclasses from the local _test_types.py
remediation: Parametrize using a dataclass imported from local _test_types.py. For framework harness inputs such as RuleCase, store their fields in the local dataclass and construct the framework object inside the test.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: pytest case ids must come from each test case description
remediation: Use ids=lambda case: case.description so failures identify the behavior clearly.

message: models role files may contain only structured runtime models
remediation: Keep imports and public structured models only. Accepted models are dataclasses and Pydantic BaseModel subclasses; move functions and other declarations to their owning role module.

message: types role files may contain only type-layer declarations
remediation: Move runtime values and functions out of types.py into their owning runtime role.

message: constants role files may contain only assignments and imports
remediation: Move functions and classes out of constants.py into their owning role module.

message: exceptions role files may contain only custom exceptions
remediation: Move non-exception declarations out of exceptions.py into their owning role.

message: structured runtime models must be defined in the models role
remediation: Move the dataclass or structured model into the owning models.py file.

constraints.description: Roles allowed to own private type declarations
constraints.name: allowed_private_type_roles

message: type-layer declarations must be defined in the types role
remediation: Move the protocol, enum, TypedDict, or public type alias into types.py.

message: public uppercase constants must be defined in the constants role
remediation: Move the public constant into constants.py and import it from there.

message: custom exceptions must be defined in the exceptions role
remediation: Move the exception class into the owning exceptions.py file.

constraints.description: Forbidden module filenames
constraints.name: forbidden_module_filenames

message: generic filenames hide module ownership
remediation: Rename the module after the domain concept or operation it owns. Forbidden module filenames: misc.py.

message: use an _helpers package instead of helpers.py
remediation: Replace helpers.py with an _helpers/ package of specifically named modules.

message: use a classes package instead of classes.py
remediation: Replace classes.py with a classes/ package containing one class per module.

constraints.description: Forbidden package names
constraints.name: forbidden_package_names

message: runtime package directories must identify an owner
remediation: Rename the package after the business domain or technical capability it owns. Forbidden package names: base, common, helpers, lib, misc, shared, util, utils. This rule owns generic bucket names; container-layout rules do not emit a duplicate fault.

message: plain classes in _helpers modules must be file-private
remediation: Prefix a file-local helper class with _, or move a shared class into classes/.

constraints.description: Forbidden role bucket names
constraints.name: forbidden_bucket_names

message: _helpers/ packages must use bounded flat-or-grouped containers
remediation: Keep _helpers/ flat or group every module into bounded shallow buckets; do not mix direct Python modules and Python-containing buckets in one container. Only direct .py files other than __init__.py count toward the module limit; empty and asset-only directories do not count as buckets. Runtime role names are not valid buckets. Container depth and entry-module shape are evaluated independently.

constraints.description: Forbidden role bucket names
constraints.name: forbidden_bucket_names

message: main/ packages must use bounded flat-or-grouped orchestration containers
remediation: Keep main/ flat or group every entry into bounded shallow buckets; do not mix direct Python modules and Python-containing buckets in one container. Only direct .py files other than __init__.py count toward the module limit; empty and asset-only directories do not count as buckets. Runtime role names are not valid buckets. Container depth and entry-module shape are evaluated independently.

constraints.description: Reserved role filenames
constraints.name: reserved_role_filenames

message: _helpers/ packages must not contain reserved role filenames
remediation: Rename the helper module after its specific operation, or move role-owned declarations to the corresponding sibling models, types, constants, or exceptions role.

constraints.description: Recognized runtime role directories
constraints.name: recognized_role_directories

constraints.description: Recognized runtime role filenames
constraints.name: recognized_role_filenames

message: nested runtime packages may contain only role-oriented direct modules
remediation: Move additional implementation modules under the package's _helpers/ boundary.

constraints.description: Recognized runtime role directories
constraints.name: recognized_role_directories

message: nested runtime packages must use explicit role boundaries
remediation: Move feature subpackages under _helpers/ or use a supported role such as main/ or classes/.

message: top-level domains must be either role leaves or subdomain branches
remediation: Keep direct role content in a leaf domain, or move it into a named subdomain when the domain contains subdomains.

constraints.description: Recognized runtime role filenames
constraints.name: recognized_role_filenames

message: top-level domains must not contain ad hoc direct modules
remediation: Move the module under a direct role boundary or into an owning named subdomain.

message: sibling domains must not encode one parent domain through a shared name prefix
remediation: Create one parent domain from the shared prefix and move each remaining suffix beneath it as a named subdomain. Setting min_shared_domain_prefix_packages to 0 disables this rule.

message: leaf runtime domains and subdomains must expose meaningful behavior through main/
remediation: Every leaf requires a direct main/ boundary with at least one non-__init__.py Python entry; branch-domain parents are exempt. Add a focused entry only when the leaf owns behavior; otherwise move passive declarations into the closest behavioral owner.

message: main/ entry modules must expose one focused public function
remediation: Every non-__init__.py module whose first structural role is main is an entry, including grouped main modules. Keep only imports, one public entry function, and at most two small private glue functions; move phase logic to _helpers/. A main bucket below another role is not an entry boundary.

message: nested __init__.py files must be empty or docstring-only
remediation: Remove runtime declarations and import from the concrete owning module instead.

constraints.description: Roles exempt from the pure re-export shim rule
constraints.name: exempt_roles

message: internal modules must not exist only to re-export imports
remediation: Import the implementation module directly or expose a deliberate API through an approved public surface.

message: _helpers/ modules must not publish an __all__ surface
remediation: Keep _helpers/ internal and expose public behavior through main/, classes/, models, types, constants, or exceptions.

message: main/ cannot define a module and package with the same entry name
remediation: Choose either the flat entry module or the same-named package and remove the competing surface.

message: root package surfaces may contain only imports and one __all__ declaration
remediation: Move runtime behavior into an owning module and keep the root __init__.py as a deliberate import surface.

message: classes/ modules must define exactly one top-level class
remediation: Split additional classes into separately named modules under classes/.

message: _helpers/ packages must contain no main.py orchestration entrypoints
remediation: Move main.py orchestration into the sibling main/ role; helper depth is enforced by FFR301.

message: private constants and dataclasses must appear before top-level functions
remediation: Move private module declarations above the first function so readers see module state before behavior.

message: source files must stay below the configured line limit
remediation: Split the file by a cohesive role or concern instead of extracting arbitrary numbered fragments.

constraints.description: Allowed direct-script command functions
constraints.name: allowed_command_functions

constraints.description: Allowed direct-script top-level statement kinds
constraints.name: allowed_top_level_statement_kinds

message: direct scripts must remain focused command adapters
remediation: Keep one public main(), optional private _parse_args() and _build_parser(), and move implementation into a scripts/<tool>/main/ entry.

constraints.description: Roles whose imported entries may be called by direct-script main()
constraints.name: allowed_imported_entry_roles

constraints.description: Allowed local direct-script main() call targets
constraints.name: allowed_local_main_call_targets

message: direct scripts must delegate to an imported main/ entrypoint
remediation: Import a typed entry function from a runtime or scripts/<tool>/main/ module and return its result from main().

message: direct scripts must stay below the configured line limit
remediation: Move command implementation into a named tooling or runtime package.

message: tooling rules/ modules may contain only decorated rule declarations
remediation: Keep imports and @rule functions here; move supporting implementation into _helpers/, classes/, models.py, types.py, constants.py, or exceptions.py.

constraints.description: Allowed tooling role directories
constraints.name: allowed_tooling_role_directories

constraints.description: Allowed tooling role files
constraints.name: allowed_tooling_role_files

message: tool packages must organize implementation through explicit roles
remediation: Use main/, _helpers/, classes/, rules/, models.py, types.py, constants.py, or exceptions.py directly beneath scripts/<tool>/.

message: rule module filenames must describe their policy rather than repeat one rule code
remediation: Rename the module after the policy or rule family it implements, using a name such as conditional_test_flow.py instead of fft104.py.

message: configured custom rules must have statically declared public-harness cases
remediation: Add statically visible RuleCase construction passed to evaluate_rule for each custom rule. When FFT413 is active, parametrize with a local _test_types.py dataclass and convert it to RuleCase inside the test. Setting min_custom_rule_test_cases to 0 disables this rule.

message: functions under no-return naming contracts must not return values
remediation: Remove the meaningful return and raise on invalid input, or rename a value-producing function as a query such as is_valid or get_validation_result.

message: predicate names must declare an ordinary boolean result
remediation: Return bool (or TypeGuard/TypeIs), or rename the function to describe the value it returns, such as read_status or current_status.

message: value-producing names must not declare a no-value result
remediation: Return the queried or converted value, or rename the function to describe its side effect, such as initialize_cache or export_json.

message: iterator names must produce an iterator or generator
remediation: Return an iterator, generator, async iterator, or async generator; otherwise rename an eager collection function with a name such as collect_items.

message: source files must be parseable
remediation: Correct the syntax error so architecture facts can be extracted reliably.

message: type roles contain only type declarations
remediation: Move runtime declarations into the main, helper, schema, or constant role that owns them.

message: constant roles contain no behavior
remediation: Move functions and classes out of constants.ts into their owning role.

message: error roles contain only error declarations
remediation: Keep typed errors in errors.ts and move other declarations to their owning role.

constraints.description: Generic module filenames that do not identify ownership
constraints.name: forbidden module filenames

message: generic filenames must not hide ownership
remediation: Rename the module after the operation or concept it owns.

constraints.description: Generic package names that do not identify a producer
constraints.name: forbidden owner names

message: generic owner names must not organize application code
remediation: Move the code beneath the named business or technical capability that owns it.

constraints.description: Role containers governed by flat-or-grouped layout limits
constraints.name: bounded role containers

message: role containers remain bounded and flat or grouped
remediation: Keep main and _helpers flat, or group every module into shallow specifically named buckets.

constraints.description: Role filenames allowed directly beneath a capability owner
constraints.name: recognized direct role files

message: owner modules live beneath explicit roles
remediation: Move the module under main, an internal role, components, or a fixed role file.

constraints.description: Directories and files that establish direct leaf-role content
constraints.name: leaf role boundaries

message: owners must be either leaves or branches
remediation: Keep roles directly in a leaf owner, or move all work into named subdomains.

message: every leaf capability exposes a main boundary
remediation: Add a focused main entry, or move passive declarations to the capability whose behavior owns them.

constraints.description: Internal role names that require a leading underscore
constraints.name: reserved internal role names

message: owner-internal role directories require an underscore prefix
remediation: Prefix the internal role with an underscore so its privacy is visible in the path.

message: runtime capabilities must not consist only of main entries
remediation: Collapse the entry into the capability that owns its inputs or output; do not add placeholder roles to preserve a main-only owner.

message: main entries expose one focused public function
remediation: Keep one public operation and move detailed phases into owner-internal modules.

constraints.description: Configured UI-kit modules may provide deliberate re-export surfaces
constraints.name: exempt configured surfaces

message: application modules must not re-export declarations
remediation: Import the defining module directly and remove the re-export or barrel.

constraints.description: Accepted state-role module suffixes
constraints.name: state module suffixes

message: state role files use the state suffix
remediation: Rename the file to <capability>.state.svelte.ts and expose one state factory.

constraints.description: Accepted resource-role module suffixes
constraints.name: resource module suffixes

message: resource role files use the resource suffix
remediation: Rename the file to <capability>.resource.svelte.ts when runes are needed, or .resource.ts otherwise.

message: runtime class modules expose one filename-aligned public class
remediation: Keep one exported runtime class per module and name its file after that class; keep related error classes in errors.ts.

message: cross-owner imports must not enter internal roles
remediation: Expose the capability through its public main, component, type, schema, or constant module.

message: directory imports must not resolve through index files
remediation: Import the concrete module that defines the symbol.

message: namespace imports hide defining modules
remediation: Import the required declarations directly from their defining modules.

message: runtime source must not import tests or tooling
remediation: Move reusable runtime behavior into src and keep test/tooling dependencies one-way.

message: private main entries remain inside their capability
remediation: Remove the leading underscore to publish the entry, or call it through a public main entry.

message: public main entries have an external consumer
remediation: Prefix the entry filename with _ until another capability, route, or tooling consumer imports it.

message: project imports must remain acyclic
remediation: Break the cycle by moving the shared contract or reversing the dependency through a public entry.

message: entry functions remain phase-shaped
remediation: Extract cohesive phases into internal helpers and keep the entry as a short ordered flow.

message: entry functions coordinate a bounded number of calls
remediation: Group related calls behind named phase helpers with explicit results.

message: entry functions keep a bounded number of locals
remediation: Move intermediate state into cohesive phase helpers that return structured results.

message: functions keep a bounded argument list
remediation: Reduce the responsibility or group cohesive inputs into a typed object.

message: runtime functions remain below the statement budget
remediation: Split the function at a meaningful behavior or phase boundary.

message: modules must stay within the imported-binding budget
remediation: Split the module at a cohesive responsibility boundary.

message: modules must stay within the public-export budget
remediation: Split the public surface into focused defining modules.

message: models role value contracts are immutable
remediation: Mark every model property readonly and use readonly arrays, tuples, or collection wrappers.

message: source modules remain below the configured line budget
remediation: Split the module by a cohesive role or concern rather than arbitrary numbered fragments.

message: public functions annotate every parameter
remediation: Annotate each public parameter with the accepted value type.

message: public functions declare return types
remediation: Declare the public return type so the capability contract is explicit.

message: non-scalar local bindings declare their types
remediation: Annotate the first non-scalar local binding, use satisfies for a checked value contract, or provide an explicit generic type argument.

message: runtime modules avoid import-time initialization
remediation: Export a factory and expose explicit initialization instead of constructing a singleton during import.

message: JSON responses require runtime decoding
remediation: Parse unknown response data through an approved runtime schema before returning or storing it.

message: JSON responses must not bypass decoding with assertions
remediation: Replace the assertion with runtime schema parsing.

message: public contracts must not expose explicit any
remediation: Replace any with a precise public type or unknown plus validation.

message: committed tests must not be skipped or empty
remediation: Implement the behavior or remove the placeholder test.

message: tests follow the configured layout
remediation: Move the test beside its source or into the configured mirrored test path.

constraints.description: Internal roles that require focused tests
constraints.name: critical tested roles

message: critical internal roles require focused tests
remediation: Add a focused test for the state, API, resource, or adapter boundary.

constraints.description: Test path scopes accepted as integration or browser coverage
constraints.name: integration test scopes

message: imperative adapters require an integration or browser test
remediation: Add an integration or e2e test for the adapter boundary.

message: parameterized test cases define description and expected fields
remediation: Use a readonly local case interface with description and expected* fields.

message: parameterized test cases define expected fields
remediation: Define at least one readonly expected* field on the inline test case type.

message: test names describe given, when, and then
remediation: Rename the test to state its precondition, action, and expected outcome.

message: parameterized cases remain inline and typed
remediation: Pass an inline object array to test.each<TestCase> beside the behavior.

message: parameterized callbacks accept testCase
remediation: Name the typed behavior-case parameter testCase and read inputs and expectations from it.

message: parameterized cases use an owner-local readonly interface
remediation: Define a readonly case interface in the test module or its owner-local _test role.

message: parameterized assertions use expected case fields
remediation: Compare outcomes with a testCase.expected* field instead of embedding an expectation.

message: test bodies avoid outcome-dependent control flow
remediation: Separate success and error behavior tables so each test body is branch-free.

message: parameterized test titles use case descriptions
remediation: Use $description as the test.each title so failures identify the behavior case.

message: parameterized tests do not mutate case data
remediation: Treat testCase and its nested values as immutable test declarations.

message: parameterized case arrays are nonempty
remediation: Add at least one behavior case or remove the empty test declaration.

message: parameterized cases use object values
remediation: Replace positional tuple cases with typed objects whose fields name each input and expectation.

message: predicate names declare boolean returns
remediation: Return boolean or rename the function to describe the value it returns.

message: validator names declare no meaningful return
remediation: Return void and throw a typed error, or rename the function as a value-producing query.

message: value-producing names declare a returned value
remediation: Return the queried value or rename the function to describe its side effect.

constraints.description: Return type families accepted for iterator naming contracts
constraints.name: iterator return types

message: iterator names declare an iterable result
remediation: Return an Iterator, Iterable, or generator, or rename the eager collection operation.

message: state modules must stay within the configured line budget
remediation: Split unrelated state responsibilities into named capabilities with focused factories.

message: rune state must not be created at module scope
remediation: Create reactive state inside a factory or component lifecycle and return an explicit facade.

message: route scripts must stay within the configured line budget
remediation: Move domain behavior into public capability entries and keep the route focused on composition.

message: component scripts must stay within the configured line budget
remediation: Extract state, transport, or domain behavior into the capability that owns it.

message: state factories stay within the mutable-cell budget
remediation: Split independently changing state into a named capability.

message: state modules stay within the rune budget
remediation: Split unrelated reactive responsibilities into named state capabilities.

message: state factories stay within the function budget
remediation: Move cohesive actions or phases to their owning capability.

message: API modules remain below the configured line budget
remediation: Split transport operations into focused endpoint modules under the owning _api role.

message: API modules expose a focused runtime surface
remediation: Split unrelated endpoint operations into focused _api modules.

message: raw fetch calls belong in API or framework loader modules
remediation: Move transport into the owning _api module and call a typed operation.

message: API endpoint literals belong in API or framework loader modules
remediation: Move the endpoint into the owning _api module and expose a typed operation.

message: components do not own route navigation
remediation: Receive a semantic navigation callback or move navigation into its named owner.

message: routes must not import another route
remediation: Promote reusable behavior into a named $lib owner and import its public entry.

message: browser modules must not import Node built-ins
remediation: Move Node-dependent behavior into a SvelteKit server module or tooling.

message: server modules must not import client state or components
remediation: Move the shared contract to a server-safe type/schema module.

message: runes belong only in Svelte-aware files
remediation: Move rune state into a .svelte, .svelte.ts, or .svelte.js module.

message: state modules expose one create-state factory
remediation: Expose exactly one create*State factory and keep rune cells inside it.

message: state facades stay within their public-member budget
remediation: Return nested capability facades instead of one broad flat object.

message: consumers do not mutate imported state directly
remediation: Call a named action owned by the imported state capability.

message: function-valued derived state uses $derived.by
remediation: Use $derived.by(() => value) or pass a direct expression to $derived.

message: effects must not own transport
remediation: Move transport into an API action and let the effect synchronize an owned resource.

message: effects must not be nested in lifecycle callbacks
remediation: Declare the effect at component or state-factory scope.

message: long-lived resources require an approved owner
remediation: Move the resource into _resources or explicit framework lifecycle code.

message: resource owners expose cleanup
remediation: Expose stop/destroy or return cleanup that releases every allocated resource.

message: shadcn aliases resolve inside the configured UI-kit
remediation: Point the shadcn UI and utility aliases at the configured UI-kit root.

message: UI-kit dependencies remain application-agnostic
remediation: Remove the application dependency or move the application-specific component into its owning capability.

message: UI-kit components use flat component-family directories
remediation: Keep utilities at the UI-kit root and component modules directly inside one named component-family directory.

message: frontend endpoints exist in OpenAPI
remediation: Use a documented endpoint or add the backend operation deliberately.

message: Dagster asset packages must use asset units without legacy pipeline files
remediation: Require sibling assets.py and main.py files, use nearest-owner roles, and remove pipeline_assets.py and pipeline_constants.py.

message: assets.py must define one asset, multi-asset, or asset factory and no private helpers
remediation: Keep one public Dagster definition in assets.py and move helper functions under _helpers/.

message: assets.py must import and call main from its sibling main.py
remediation: Import main from the exact sibling module and use only return main(...) or a precisely typed yield from main(...).

message: Dagster main.py must contain only imports and one main() with an approved result contract
remediation: Use dg.MaterializeResult for single results, a precise Iterator/Generator of Dagster events for event streams, or NoReturn/Never for an intentional non-returning probe.

message: Dagster asset callbacks must accept positional context and keyword-only injected dependencies
remediation: Keep context as the sole positional argument and place * before resources and configuration.

message: Dagster asset imports must use approved owner, dependency, utility, and resource boundaries
remediation: Use owner-local support, public utilities, or resources; import another asset definition only for statically provable deps.

message: job, schedule, and sensor modules may expose only Dagster definitions
remediation: Make supporting constants and selections private or move substantive behavior to its owning module.

message: job, schedule, and sensor trees must use semantic modules and sanctioned private support roles
remediation: Flatten generic wrappers into role/domain/<capability>.py and use only directory-private _models.py, _types.py, _exceptions.py, _constants.py, or _helpers/ for extracted support.

message: private job, schedule, and sensor support modules may only be imported within their owning directory
remediation: Keep the import in the support module's immediate owning directory or move genuinely shared behavior outside defs/ to its runtime owner.

message: operational resource packages must use explicit resource and support roles
remediation: Keep the ConfigurableResource, factory, and binding in <capability>/resource.py; use explicit public support roles, semantic _helpers modules for private functions, and semantic _classes modules for private collaborator classes.

message: definitions providers must be declared honestly instead of cast to another Dagster definition type
remediation: Declare a semantic @dg.definitions function returning dg.Definitions and remove casts or misleading JobDefinition, ScheduleDefinition, or SensorDefinition annotations.

message: asset configs must use semantic modules with one concrete config and one same-file binding
remediation: Move the config to defs/resources/asset_configs/<asset-domain>/<capability>.py, rename BaseConfig scopes to <Scope>PipelineConfig in pipeline.py, and bind that class from the module's sole @dg.definitions provider.

message: dynamic imports and string-based module references are forbidden
remediation: Use a concrete import, patch.object(module, name, ...), module.__name__, or package-module definition discovery instead of module-path strings.

message: structured runtime models must use the models role or an automation-private _models.py alias
remediation: Move the model to models.py, a models/ package, or an owner-local _models.py beneath defs/jobs, defs/schedules, or defs/sensors.

message: custom exceptions must use the exceptions role or an automation-private _exceptions.py alias
remediation: Move the exception to exceptions.py, an exceptions/ package, or an owner-local _exceptions.py beneath defs/jobs, defs/schedules, or defs/sensors.

message: private support packages may only be imported within their owning package subtree
remediation: Import _helpers and _classes modules only from within their owning package subtree; move shared public APIs to an explicit public role.

message: _classes modules may contain only private class declarations and imports
remediation: Prefix every class with `_`; move functions to _helpers, models to models.py, constants to constants.py, and module state inside the owning class or resource.

message: source-root paths must belong to the explicit architecture allowlist
remediation: Keep only package and definition entrypoints at the source root; move runtime modules beneath defs or utils.

message: production modules must not import from the tooling root
remediation: Move shared runtime behavior beneath defs or utils and keep tooling as a one-way command boundary.

message: runtime package directories must identify an owner
remediation: Rename generic packages after their business or technical capability; only the sanctioned source-root utils boundary is exempt.

message: test-root directories must be supported scopes
remediation: Move tests beneath unit, integration, or e2e; configure deliberate non-Python test roots separately.

message: Dagster autoload must not reach external discovery outside an approved loader boundary

options.description: Exact project functions allowed to encapsulate external discovery during Dagster autoload.
options.name: approved_loader_boundaries

remediation: Move subprocess, network, database, SSH, and remote-client discovery behind an exact approved project function.

message: type-layer declarations must use the types role or an automation-private _types.py alias
remediation: Move the type to types.py or an owner-local _types.py beneath defs/jobs, defs/schedules, or defs/sensors.

message: function parameters must define type annotations
remediation: Annotate every parameter with the value type accepted by the function.

message: functions must define return type annotations
remediation: Declare the returned value type, using None when the function returns no value.

message: module-level variables must define type annotations
remediation: Add an explicit annotation to the first module-level assignment.

message: class attributes must define type annotations
remediation: Annotate the class attribute where it is first assigned.

message: local variables must define type annotations on first binding unless assigned a scalar literal
remediation: Annotate first bindings whose type is not evident from a number, string, bool, bytes, or f-string literal.

message: use absolute imports; relative imports hide package boundaries
remediation: Replace relative imports with an absolute import path.

message: star imports hide names from dependency-boundary analysis
remediation: Import each required name explicitly.

constraints.description: Subdomain paths exempt from internal public-surface imports
constraints.name: exempt_subdomain_paths

message: internal code must import from the owning module, not the bare package
remediation: Import from the concrete owning module below the package surface.

message: domain-private main entries may only be imported within their owning domain
remediation: Remove the leading underscore to publish the main entry, or route the caller through a public main entry owned by the target domain.

message: public main entries must have an importer outside their owning domain
remediation: Prefix the entry module filename with '_' until another domain or tooling imports it.

message: helper-private classes are file-local details; move shared classes to classes/
remediation: If another module needs this class, move it to the owning classes/ package.

message: runtime code must not import from tooling modules
remediation: Move reusable logic into the runtime package or keep the dependency inside tooling.

message: docstrings must be a single line; move extended explanation into docs or tests
remediation: Keep one concise summary line and move extended rationale into documentation or tests.

constraints.description: Allowed standalone comment prefixes
constraints.name: allowed_standalone_comment_prefixes

message: standalone comments are not allowed; prefer clear names or docs/tests
remediation: Replace the comment with clearer names or move lasting explanation into documentation or tests. Tooling directives beginning with these prefixes are allowed: #!, # -*-, # coding:, # noqa, # type:, # pyright:, # pylint:, # pragma:.

message: runtime code must raise structured errors instead of raw built-in exceptions
remediation: Raise a domain-specific exception from exceptions.py with a stable actionable message.

message: runtime code must not use assert for invariants; raise a structured error
remediation: Replace assert with an explicit guard that raises a domain-specific exception.

message: runtime code must not swallow broad exceptions as existence probe answers
remediation: Use an explicit metadata or existence check, or catch only the expected exception and preserve failures.

message: nested or multi-generator comprehensions hide control flow and data shapes
remediation: Extract a named helper when the transformation has a coherent purpose. For one-off local logic, use simple statements with named intermediate values instead of nested comprehension control flow.

message: string literals must not directly control comparison behavior
remediation: Name the decision value in constants.py or compare against an enum member so the branch expresses the concept it represents.

message: non-canonical numeric literals must not directly control comparisons
remediation: Name the threshold or sentinel in constants.py and compare against that name; only -1, 0, and 1 are self-explanatory comparison values.

message: runtime and tooling modules must not execute standalone calls during import
remediation: Move the operation into an explicit function or assign a pure constructor result.

message: main functions must stay phase-shaped and below the statement limit
remediation: Extract cohesive phases into helpers that return explicit result models.

message: main functions must not coordinate too many distinct callees
remediation: Group related work into named phase helpers and keep main/ as a short ordered flow.

message: main functions must not juggle too many local variables
remediation: Let each extracted phase own its intermediates and return one structured result.

message: functions must stay below the configured argument limit
remediation: Reduce the function's responsibility or group cohesive inputs into a typed model.

message: functions must stay below the global statement limit
remediation: Split the function at a meaningful phase boundary with explicit inputs and outputs. Top-level main functions are governed by FFS001 instead.

message: main orchestrators must consume meaningful project-local call results
remediation: Assign, return, or explicitly discard the phase result with _ = call(...).

constraints.description: Function kinds exempt from parameter-mutation enforcement
constraints.name: exempt_function_kinds

message: helpers must return values instead of mutating parameters
remediation: Return a new or updated value so dataflow remains visible to the caller.

constraints.description: Function kinds exempt from parameter-mutation enforcement
constraints.name: exempt_function_kinds

message: functions that mutate parameters must return every mutated parameter
remediation: Return each mutated parameter explicitly, or avoid parameter mutation and return a new value.

message: functions must not mutate module-global or closure-captured state
remediation: Pass state explicitly and return the updated value instead of mutating outer scope.

message: nested or multi-generator comprehensions hide control flow and data shapes
remediation: Extract a named helper when the transformation has a coherent purpose. For one-off local logic, use simple statements with named intermediate values instead of nested comprehension control flow.

message: dataclass result models must be frozen
remediation: Declare the shared result model with @dataclass(frozen=True).

message: tests must live under a configured test root and supported scope
remediation: Move the test beneath a configured test root and one of the configured test_scopes.

message: test scope must be one of the configured test scopes
remediation: Move the test beneath a configured test root and one of the configured test_scopes.

message: test directories must mirror a configured runtime or tooling root
remediation: Mirror the complete configured source or tooling path beneath the test scope.

message: runtime tests must include an area beneath the configured source root
remediation: Move the test beneath the package and source area it exercises.

message: runtime tests must mirror a configured source package
remediation: Correct the mirrored package name or move the test to the package it exercises.

message: runtime tests must mirror an existing source package area
remediation: Correct the mirrored area path so it matches the runtime module location.

message: tooling tests must include an area beneath the configured tooling root
remediation: Move the test beneath the configured tooling area it exercises.

message: tooling tests must mirror an existing configured tooling area
remediation: Correct the mirrored area path so it matches the tooling location.

message: test package __init__.py files must be empty or docstring-only
remediation: Remove runtime declarations from __init__.py and import them from their owning module.

message: tests must use absolute imports
remediation: Replace the relative import with the full tests or application package path.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: test modules may contain only tests, imports, and declarations
remediation: Move reusable functions into the local helpers.py module.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

constraints.description: Test helper filenames included in conditional-flow enforcement
constraints.name: helper_module_filenames

message: tests and local test helpers must not contain conditional control flow
remediation: Use parametrized cases when setup and assertions remain branch-free; otherwise split the behavior into separate test functions. Keep local test helpers deterministic with per-variant functions or dataclass-driven case data.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: private test constants must appear before test functions
remediation: Move the private constant above the first test so module setup is visible before behavior.

message: nested or multi-generator comprehensions hide control flow and data shapes
remediation: Extract a named helper when the transformation has a coherent purpose. For one-off local logic, use simple statements with named intermediate values instead of nested comprehension control flow.

message: test-case dataclasses must define a description field
remediation: Add description: str so parametrized cases explain the behavior they represent.

message: test-case dataclasses must define at least one expected_ field
remediation: Name expected outcomes with an expected_ prefix and assert against them in the test.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: tests must import test-case types from their local _test_types.py
remediation: Move the dataclass beside the test and import it through the mirrored absolute path.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: test directories must provide a local _test_types.py
remediation: Create _test_types.py beside the test. Custom-rule tests should define a local wrapper dataclass there rather than parametrizing directly with RuleCase.

constraints.description: Scenario model filenames requiring dataclass-only declarations
constraints.name: scenario_model_filenames

message: scenario model modules may contain only imports and dataclass declarations
remediation: Decorate each scenario model with @dataclass or move non-model behavior into a focused helper module.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: test modules must use a test_ filename
remediation: Rename the module to test_<behavior>.py.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: test functions must use test_given_<state>_when_<action>_then_<outcome>
remediation: Rename the test so its precondition, action, and expected behavior are explicit.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: tests must use dataclass-backed pytest parameterization
remediation: Add @pytest.mark.parametrize with local test_case dataclass instances.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: parametrized tests must accept a test_case argument
remediation: Name the parameter test_case and read inputs and expectations from that object.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: test_case parameters must use a local test-case dataclass annotation
remediation: Annotate test_case with a dataclass imported from the local _test_types.py.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: tests must assert against an expected_ field from test_case
remediation: Store the expected outcome on test_case and reference it in a behavior assertion.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: pytest parametrize decorators must define parameter names and values
remediation: Pass both the parameter-name string and the case sequence to parametrize.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: pytest parametrize must expose cases through the test_case parameter
remediation: Use "test_case" as the parametrize parameter name.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: pytest parametrize decorators must define readable case ids
remediation: Set ids to the case descriptions, normally with ids=lambda case: case.description.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: pytest parametrize values must be a visible list, tuple, or local comprehension
remediation: Inline the case sequence in @pytest.mark.parametrize so its cases are visible beside the test.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: pytest parametrize case sequences must not be empty
remediation: Add at least one behavior case or remove the test until a real case exists.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: pytest cases must use typed dataclasses instead of dictionaries
remediation: Define a local frozen test-case dataclass and construct one instance per case.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: pytest cases must construct dataclasses from the local _test_types.py
remediation: Parametrize using a dataclass imported from local _test_types.py. For framework harness inputs such as RuleCase, store their fields in the local dataclass and construct the framework object inside the test.

constraints.description: Test support filenames excluded from this test-module rule
constraints.name: excluded_test_support_filenames

message: pytest case ids must come from each test case description
remediation: Use ids=lambda case: case.description so failures identify the behavior clearly.

message: models role files may contain only structured runtime models
remediation: Keep imports and public structured models only. Accepted models are dataclasses and Pydantic BaseModel subclasses; move functions and other declarations to their owning role module.

message: types role files may contain only type-layer declarations
remediation: Move runtime values and functions out of types.py into their owning runtime role.

message: constants role files may contain only assignments and imports
remediation: Move functions and classes out of constants.py into their owning role module.

message: exceptions role files may contain only custom exceptions
remediation: Move non-exception declarations out of exceptions.py into their owning role.

message: public uppercase constants must be defined in the constants role
remediation: Move the public constant into constants.py and import it from there.

constraints.description: Forbidden module filenames
constraints.name: forbidden_module_filenames

message: generic filenames hide module ownership
remediation: Rename the module after the domain concept or operation it owns. Forbidden module filenames: misc.py.

message: use an _helpers package instead of helpers.py
remediation: Replace helpers.py with an _helpers/ package of specifically named modules.

message: use a classes package instead of classes.py
remediation: Replace classes.py with a classes/ package containing one class per module.

message: plain classes in _helpers modules must be file-private
remediation: Prefix a file-local helper class with _, or move a shared class into classes/.

constraints.description: Forbidden role bucket names
constraints.name: forbidden_bucket_names

message: _helpers/ packages must use bounded flat-or-grouped containers
remediation: Keep _helpers/ flat or group every module into bounded shallow buckets; do not mix direct Python modules and Python-containing buckets in one container. Only direct .py files other than __init__.py count toward the module limit; empty and asset-only directories do not count as buckets. Runtime role names are not valid buckets. Container depth and entry-module shape are evaluated independently.

constraints.description: Forbidden role bucket names
constraints.name: forbidden_bucket_names

message: main/ packages must use bounded flat-or-grouped orchestration containers
remediation: Keep main/ flat or group every entry into bounded shallow buckets; do not mix direct Python modules and Python-containing buckets in one container. Only direct .py files other than __init__.py count toward the module limit; empty and asset-only directories do not count as buckets. Runtime role names are not valid buckets. Container depth and entry-module shape are evaluated independently.

constraints.description: Reserved role filenames
constraints.name: reserved_role_filenames

message: _helpers/ packages must not contain reserved role filenames
remediation: Rename the helper module after its specific operation, or move role-owned declarations to the corresponding sibling models, types, constants, or exceptions role.

message: top-level domains must be either role leaves or subdomain branches
remediation: Keep direct role content in a leaf domain, or move it into a named subdomain when the domain contains subdomains.

constraints.description: Recognized runtime role filenames
constraints.name: recognized_role_filenames

message: top-level domains must not contain ad hoc direct modules
remediation: Move the module under a direct role boundary or into an owning named subdomain.

message: sibling domains must not encode one parent domain through a shared name prefix
remediation: Create one parent domain from the shared prefix and move each remaining suffix beneath it as a named subdomain. Setting min_shared_domain_prefix_packages to 0 disables this rule.

message: main/ entry modules must expose one focused public function
remediation: Every non-__init__.py module whose first structural role is main is an entry, including grouped main modules. Keep only imports, one public entry function, and at most two small private glue functions; move phase logic to _helpers/. A main bucket below another role is not an entry boundary.

message: nested __init__.py files must be empty or docstring-only
remediation: Remove runtime declarations and import from the concrete owning module instead.

constraints.description: Roles exempt from the pure re-export shim rule
constraints.name: exempt_roles

message: internal modules must not exist only to re-export imports
remediation: Import the implementation module directly or expose a deliberate API through an approved public surface.

message: _helpers/ modules must not publish an __all__ surface
remediation: Keep _helpers/ internal and expose public behavior through main/, classes/, models, types, constants, or exceptions.

message: main/ cannot define a module and package with the same entry name
remediation: Choose either the flat entry module or the same-named package and remove the competing surface.

message: root package surfaces may contain only imports and one __all__ declaration
remediation: Move runtime behavior into an owning module and keep the root __init__.py as a deliberate import surface.

message: classes/ modules must define exactly one top-level class
remediation: Split additional classes into separately named modules under classes/.

message: _helpers/ packages must contain no main.py orchestration entrypoints
remediation: Move main.py orchestration into the sibling main/ role; helper depth is enforced by FFR301.

message: private constants and dataclasses must appear before top-level functions
remediation: Move private module declarations above the first function so readers see module state before behavior.

message: source files must stay below the configured line limit
remediation: Split the file by a cohesive role or concern instead of extracting arbitrary numbered fragments.

constraints.description: Allowed direct-script command functions
constraints.name: allowed_command_functions

constraints.description: Allowed direct-script top-level statement kinds
constraints.name: allowed_top_level_statement_kinds

message: direct scripts must remain focused command adapters
remediation: Keep one public main(), optional private _parse_args() and _build_parser(), and move implementation into a scripts/<tool>/main/ entry.

constraints.description: Roles whose imported entries may be called by direct-script main()
constraints.name: allowed_imported_entry_roles

constraints.description: Allowed local direct-script main() call targets
constraints.name: allowed_local_main_call_targets

message: direct scripts must delegate to an imported main/ entrypoint
remediation: Import a typed entry function from a runtime or scripts/<tool>/main/ module and return its result from main().

message: direct scripts must stay below the configured line limit
remediation: Move command implementation into a named tooling or runtime package.

message: tooling rules/ modules may contain only decorated rule declarations
remediation: Keep imports and @rule functions here; move supporting implementation into _helpers/, classes/, models.py, types.py, constants.py, or exceptions.py.

constraints.description: Allowed tooling role directories
constraints.name: allowed_tooling_role_directories

constraints.description: Allowed tooling role files
constraints.name: allowed_tooling_role_files

message: tool packages must organize implementation through explicit roles
remediation: Use main/, _helpers/, classes/, rules/, models.py, types.py, constants.py, or exceptions.py directly beneath scripts/<tool>/.

message: rule module filenames must describe their policy rather than repeat one rule code
remediation: Rename the module after the policy or rule family it implements, using a name such as conditional_test_flow.py instead of fft104.py.

message: configured custom rules must have statically declared public-harness cases
remediation: Add statically visible RuleCase construction passed to evaluate_rule for each custom rule. When FFT413 is active, parametrize with a local _test_types.py dataclass and convert it to RuleCase inside the test. Setting min_custom_rule_test_cases to 0 disables this rule.

message: functions under no-return naming contracts must not return values
remediation: Remove the meaningful return and raise on invalid input, or rename a value-producing function as a query such as is_valid or get_validation_result.

message: predicate names must declare an ordinary boolean result
remediation: Return bool (or TypeGuard/TypeIs), or rename the function to describe the value it returns, such as read_status or current_status.

message: value-producing names must not declare a no-value result
